raw_entities.title: Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models
raw_entities.content: Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.
raw_entities.key_equation: E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2

raw_entities.title: Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics
raw_entities.content: Combines Robbins-Monro stochastic gradient optimization with Langevin dynamics by injecting calibrated Gaussian noise omega^k ~ N(0, alpha) into gradient updates of the unnormalized log-posterior or energy function E(x). As step size alpha -> 0 and iteration K -> infinity, Markov chain trajectories sample from the exact Boltzmann posterior distribution p(x) proportional to exp(-E(x))/Z without Metropolis-Hastings accept-reject steps.
raw_entities.key_equation: x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)

raw_entities.title: Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control
raw_entities.authors: Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel
raw_entities.content: Learns neural network cost (energy) functions from expert demonstration trajectories under the Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning Boltzmann model p(x) = exp(-E_theta(x))/Z. Approximates the intractable partition function Z using importance sampling with mixture distribution q(x) = 0.5 p_demo(x) + 0.5 pi(x), while minimizing KL divergence KL(pi || exp(-E_theta)/Z) so the sampling distribution pi generates low-energy negative samples.

raw_entities.title: Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence
raw_entities.content: Approximates intractable log-likelihood gradients of the partition function Z in Boltzmann and energy-based models by running a short K-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) or Langevin sampler to draw negative samples x^K. Contrasts positive data energy E(x^0) against negative sample energy E(x^K).
raw_entities.key_equation: Delta theta proportional to grad_theta E(x^0) - grad_theta E(x^K)

raw_entities.title: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning
raw_entities.content: Models demonstrated trajectories x as samples from a Boltzmann distribution p(x|w) = exp(-E(x,w))/Z(w) parameterized by path energy E(x,w) and partition function Z(w). Multiple constraints or concepts compose additively by summing their constituent energy functions.

raw_entities.title: Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping
raw_entities.content: CONTROVERSY / CONTRADICTION NOTE: Classical contrastive divergence (Hinton 2002) assumes K-step truncated Langevin MCMC chains mix sufficiently without differentiating through the sampler. However, our experiments contradict uncalibrated short-run MCMC: when training the energy function E_theta with L^ML alone, K=10 Langevin steps fail to reach low-energy modes of the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z (sampled energy stays > 0.74). Differentiating through the K-step SGLD rollout via the sampler KL objective L^KL is mandatory to shape the gradient field grad_x E_theta.
raw_entities.key_equation: KL(pi_K || p_Boltzmann) >> 0 when trained with L^ML only

raw_entities.title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation (MAML)
raw_entities.authors: Chelsea Finn, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine
raw_entities.content: Trains meta-parameters theta via end-to-end backpropagation through an execution-time inner-loop gradient descent adaptation procedure. Given few-shot demonstration examples X^demo, K inner-loop gradient steps infer task-adapted parameters w*(X^demo), and the outer meta-objective optimizes theta so adapted parameters generalize on X^train.

raw_entities.title: Concept Acquisition via Meta-Learning from Positive Examples
raw_entities.authors: Erin Grant, Chelsea Finn, Joshua B. Tenenbaum et al.
raw_entities.content: Formulates few-shot Bayesian concept acquisition from positive demonstration examples X^demo as execution-time inner-loop gradient adaptation in MAML. Inferring concept code w* minimizes energy over positive demonstrations while meta-learned prior structure in theta prevents collapse.

raw_entities.title: TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text
raw_entities.authors: Mert Yuksekgonul, Carlos Guestrin, James Zou et al.
raw_entities.content: Generalizes backpropagation and inner-loop gradient descent adaptation to discrete natural-language variables v (prompts, code, or wiki pages). An LLM Critic evaluates a loss or energy rubric and backpropagates natural-language textual gradients grad^{text}_v E explaining how to edit v^{k-1} at execution time across K iterative refinement steps.

raw_entities.title: ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization with Textual Gradients
raw_entities.content: Performs execution-time inner-loop adaptation of natural language instructions using nonparametric textual gradients. An LLM critic diagnoses failure minibatches on demonstration examples and emits natural-language edit critiques that guide iterative semantic gradient descent.

raw_entities.title: A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning
raw_entities.authors: Adam Santoro, Peter Battaglia, Timothy Lillicrap et al.
raw_entities.content: Computes pairwise relational interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) across all entity pairs (i, j) gated by attention masks and aggregates them via f_phi. Captures multi-entity compositional, spatial, and graph topology relations where independent unary entity encoders fail.
raw_entities.key_equation: RN(O) = f_phi( sum_{i,j} g_theta(o_i, o_j, q) )

raw_entities.title: DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache Timeout & Pairwise Wiki-Link Textual Gradients
raw_entities.content: Morning standup: fixed Redis connection pool timeout on staging node-04 by bumping max_clients. Afternoon research note on LLM Wiki compilation: when running inner-loop textual gradient descent (TextGrad / ProTeGi adaptation) to compile wiki pages, unary critiques miss cross-document links. By gating pairwise relation critiques g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) with attention product sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j), the critic emits explicit LINK_DEFICIT textual gradients that wire bidirectional [[wiki-links]] between co-attended entities during K-step execution-time adaptation.

raw_entities.title: Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling
raw_entities.content: Analyzes commercial building HVAC thermal energy consumption, chiller partition valves, and power grid peak-load balancing. Temperature gradient sensors across rooftop air handlers use 5-minute interval sampling to regulate ductwork dampers, heat pumps, and thermostat setpoints in office zones.

raw_entities.title: Agricultural Soil Core Sampling & Moisture Gradient Partitioning
raw_entities.content: Protocol for stratified soil core sampling across nitrogen fertilizer plots and watershed partition zones. Measures vertical moisture gradient profiles, root-zone microbial energy respiration, and seasonal crop rotation adaptation in loamy clay fields.

raw_entities.title: Bug #884: Safari CSS Linear-Gradient Flicker & DOM Attention Focus
raw_entities.content: Fixes GPU compositing flicker when animating CSS linear-gradient and radial-gradient backgrounds inside scrollable modal overlays. Adjusts keyboard tab-index attention focus rings and pairwise flexbox sibling margins on retina viewports.

raw_entities.title: Q4 Organizational Adaptation & Peer Feedback Critique Guidelines
raw_entities.content: Guidelines for quarterly team adaptation, onboarding demonstration workshops, and constructive written peer critiques during performance review cycles. Encourages cross-functional communication bridges between product managers and account executives.

raw_entities.title: Postmortem: PostgreSQL Transaction ID Wraparound & Autovacuum Tuning
raw_entities.content: Root cause analysis of replica lag spike on primary billing database shard-02. Long-running analytics transactions blocked autovacuum from freezing dead tuples in theWAL segment directory. Tuned vacuum_cost_limit and added pg_stat_activity alert thresholds.

raw_entities.title: Runbook: Kubernetes NGINX Ingress TLS Certificate Rotation via Cert-Manager
raw_entities.content: Step-by-step runbook for diagnosing Let's Encrypt ACME HTTP-01 challenge failures on Kubernetes ingress-nginx pods. Inspect ClusterIssuer webhook logs, verify Route53 DNS CAA records, and delete stale CertificateRequest secrets.

# Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_ebm_sampling`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Identify KB notes grounded in [energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function, gradient, sampling, trajectory] whose contextual formulations co-depend on shared probabilistic or optimization mechanisms (rejecting polysemous noise).
- **Relational Synthesis Code ($\mathbf{w}_x$):** Compile a canonical wiki synthesis around [energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function, gradient, sampling, trajectory], wiring bidirectional [[wiki-links]] and reconciling contradictions across attended notes.
- **Discovered Mechanisms:** `energy`, `boltzmann`, `langevin`, `partition_function`, `gradient`, `sampling`, `trajectory`

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 18 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **6 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps (`trap_hvac_building_energy`, `trap_agronomy_soil_sampling`, `trap_css_gradient_ui_bug`):

### [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Igor Mordatch (OpenAI), 2018)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.962` — *Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.48.*
- **Extracted Note:** Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Max Welling, Yee Whye Teh, 2011)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.959` — *Promote 'Bayesian Learning via Stochast': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.47.*
- **Extracted Note:** Combines Robbins-Monro stochastic gradient optimization with Langevin dynamics by injecting calibrated Gaussian noise omega^k ~ N(0, alpha) into gradient updates of the unnormalized log-posterior or energy function E(x). As step size alpha -> 0 and iteration K -> infinity, Markov chain trajectories sample from the exact Boltzmann posterior distribution p(x) proportional to exp(-E(x))/Z without Metropolis-Hastings accept-reject steps.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel, 2016)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `L_IOC(theta) = E_{x~demo}[E_theta(x)] + log E_{x~q}[exp(-E_theta(x)) / q(x)]`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.955` — *Promote 'Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inv': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'partition_function'], pairwise_synergy=0.48.*
- **Extracted Note:** Learns neural network cost (energy) functions from expert demonstration trajectories under the Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning Boltzmann model p(x) = exp(-E_theta(x))/Z. Approximates the intractable partition function Z using importance sampling with mixture distribution q(x) = 0.5 p_demo(x) + 0.5 pi(x), while minimizing KL divergence KL(pi || exp(-E_theta)/Z) so the sampling distribution pi generates low-energy negative samples.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Geoffrey E. Hinton, 2002)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `Delta theta proportional to grad_theta E(x^0) - grad_theta E(x^K)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.955` — *Promote 'Training Products of Experts b': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.48.*
- **Extracted Note:** Approximates intractable log-likelihood gradients of the partition function Z in Boltzmann and energy-based models by running a short K-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) or Langevin sampler to draw negative samples x^K. Contrasts positive data energy E(x^0) against negative sample energy E(x^K).

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Brian D. Ziebart et al., 2008)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `p(x | w) = (1 / Z(w)) exp(-E(x, w))`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.949` — *Promote 'Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinfo': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'partition_function'], pairwise_synergy=0.47.*
- **Extracted Note:** Models demonstrated trajectories x as samples from a Boltzmann distribution p(x|w) = exp(-E(x,w))/Z(w) parameterized by path energy E(x,w) and partition function Z(w). Multiple constraints or concepts compose additively by summing their constituent energy functions.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Smart Grid HVAC Thermal Energy Consumption & Sensor Sampling]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]] `[CONTRADICTION_NOTE]` (Research Lab Internal Note, 2025)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `KL(pi_K || p_Boltzmann) >> 0 when trained with L^ML only`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.953` — *Promote 'Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Ru': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.46.*
- **Extracted Note:** CONTROVERSY / CONTRADICTION NOTE: Classical contrastive divergence (Hinton 2002) assumes K-step truncated Langevin MCMC chains mix sufficiently without differentiating through the sampler. However, our experiments contradict uncalibrated short-run MCMC: when training the energy function E_theta with L^ML alone, K=10 Langevin steps fail to reach low-energy modes of the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z (sampled energy stays > 0.74). Differentiating through the K-step SGLD rollout via the sampler KL objective L^KL is mandatory to shape the gradient field grad_x E_theta.

# Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_inner_loop_textgrad`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Identify KB notes grounded in [gradient, inner_loop, adaptation] whose contextual formulations co-depend on shared probabilistic or optimization mechanisms (rejecting polysemous noise).
- **Relational Synthesis Code ($\mathbf{w}_x$):** Compile a canonical wiki synthesis around [gradient, inner_loop, adaptation], wiring bidirectional [[wiki-links]] and reconciling contradictions across attended notes.
- **Discovered Mechanisms:** `gradient`, `inner_loop`, `adaptation`

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 18 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **3 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps (`trap_hvac_building_energy`, `trap_agronomy_soil_sampling`, `trap_css_gradient_ui_bug`):

### [[Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation (MAML)]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Chelsea Finn, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, 2017)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `min_theta L(theta - alpha grad_theta L_demo(theta))`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.645` — *Promote 'Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning f': unary=['adaptation', 'gradient', 'inner_loop'], pairwise_synergy=0.28.*
- **Extracted Note:** Trains meta-parameters theta via end-to-end backpropagation through an execution-time inner-loop gradient descent adaptation procedure. Given few-shot demonstration examples X^demo, K inner-loop gradient steps infer task-adapted parameters w*(X^demo), and the outer meta-objective optimizes theta so adapted parameters generalize on X^train.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Acquisition via Meta-Learning from Positive Examples]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization with Textual Gradients]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache Timeout & Pairwise Wiki-Link Textual Gradients]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

### [[TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Mert Yuksekgonul, Carlos Guestrin, James Zou et al., 2024)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `v^k = Optimizer_LLM(v^{k-1}, grad^{text}_v E(v^{k-1}))`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.644` — *Promote 'TextGrad: Automatic Differenti': unary=['adaptation', 'gradient', 'inner_loop'], pairwise_synergy=0.29.*
- **Extracted Note:** Generalizes backpropagation and inner-loop gradient descent adaptation to discrete natural-language variables v (prompts, code, or wiki pages). An LLM Critic evaluates a loss or energy rubric and backpropagates natural-language textual gradients grad^{text}_v E explaining how to edit v^{k-1} at execution time across K iterative refinement steps.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation (MAML)]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Acquisition via Meta-Learning from Positive Examples]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

### [[ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization with Textual Gradients]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Reid Pryzant et al., 2023)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `g = Critic_LLM(errors),  w^k = Edit_LLM(w^{k-1}, g)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.659` — *Promote 'ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization w': unary=['adaptation', 'gradient', 'inner_loop'], pairwise_synergy=0.36.*
- **Extracted Note:** Performs execution-time inner-loop adaptation of natural language instructions using nonparametric textual gradients. An LLM critic diagnoses failure minibatches on demonstration examples and emits natural-language edit critiques that guide iterative semantic gradient descent.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation (MAML)]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation.

concept_page.content:
# Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_relational_reasoning`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Identify notes modeling pairwise entity interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) gated by attention sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j).
- **Relational Synthesis Code ($\mathbf{w}_x$):** Synthesize pairwise relation networks, entangled dev logs, and entity-gated energy models via [[wiki-links]].
- **Discovered Mechanisms:** `relational`, `pairwise`, `attention`, `compositional`, `gradient`

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 18 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **3 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps (`trap_hvac_building_energy`, `trap_agronomy_soil_sampling`, `trap_css_gradient_ui_bug`):

### [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Igor Mordatch (OpenAI), 2018)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.966` — *Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['a_i', 'a_j', 'attention'], pairwise_synergy=0.45.*
- **Extracted Note:** Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache Timeout & Pairwise Wiki-Link Textual Gradients]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

### [[A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Adam Santoro, Peter Battaglia, Timothy Lillicrap et al., 2017)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `RN(O) = f_phi( sum_{i,j} g_theta(o_i, o_j, q) )`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.954` — *Promote 'A Simple Neural Network Module': unary=['attention', 'compositional', 'entity'], pairwise_synergy=0.33.*
- **Extracted Note:** Computes pairwise relational interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) across all entity pairs (i, j) gated by attention masks and aggregates them via f_phi. Captures multi-entity compositional, spatial, and graph topology relations where independent unary entity encoders fail.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache Timeout & Pairwise Wiki-Link Textual Gradients]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

### [[DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache Timeout & Pairwise Wiki-Link Textual Gradients]] `[DEV_LOG]` (Platform ML Eng Team, 2026)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `grad_{x^1} E_theta = LINK_DEFICIT([[x_i]] <-> [[x_j]]) when sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) > 0.25`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.959` — *Promote 'DevLog 2026-11-12: Redis Cache': unary=['a_i', 'a_j', 'attention'], pairwise_synergy=0.36.*
- **Extracted Note:** Morning standup: fixed Redis connection pool timeout on staging node-04 by bumping max_clients. Afternoon research note on LLM Wiki compilation: when running inner-loop textual gradient descent (TextGrad / ProTeGi adaptation) to compile wiki pages, unary critiques miss cross-document links. By gating pairwise relation critiques g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) with attention product sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j), the critic emits explicit LINK_DEFICIT textual gradients that wire bidirectional [[wiki-links]] between co-attended entities during K-step execution-time adaptation.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Attention-Gated Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

# Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_composite_ebm_meta`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Composite Sum E(w_1) + E(w_2): (Boltzmann Energy, Partition Function & Langevin Sampling) + (Execution-Time Inner-Loop Adaptation & Textual Gradients)
- **Relational Synthesis Code ($\mathbf{w}_x$):** Bridge Boltzmann partition sampling with inner-loop meta-learning and textual gradient updates.
- **Discovered Mechanisms:** `energy`, `boltzmann`, `langevin`, `partition_function`, `gradient`, `sampling`, `trajectory`, `inner_loop`, `adaptation`

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 18 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **6 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps (`trap_hvac_building_energy`, `trap_agronomy_soil_sampling`, `trap_css_gradient_ui_bug`):

### [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Igor Mordatch (OpenAI), 2018)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.664` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.47. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Concept Learning with Energy': off-concept clutter (overlap=['gradient', 'inner_loop']).*
- **Extracted Note:** Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Max Welling, Yee Whye Teh, 2011)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.653` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Bayesian Learning via Stochast': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.44. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Bayesian Learning via Stocha': off-concept clutter (overlap=['gradient', 'noise', 'optimization']).*
- **Extracted Note:** Combines Robbins-Monro stochastic gradient optimization with Langevin dynamics by injecting calibrated Gaussian noise omega^k ~ N(0, alpha) into gradient updates of the unnormalized log-posterior or energy function E(x). As step size alpha -> 0 and iteration K -> infinity, Markov chain trajectories sample from the exact Boltzmann posterior distribution p(x) proportional to exp(-E(x))/Z without Metropolis-Hastings accept-reject steps.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel, 2016)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `L_IOC(theta) = E_{x~demo}[E_theta(x)] + log E_{x~q}[exp(-E_theta(x)) / q(x)]`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.536` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inv': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'partition_function'], pairwise_synergy=0.45. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Guided Cost Learning: Deep I': off-concept clutter (overlap=[]).*
- **Extracted Note:** Learns neural network cost (energy) functions from expert demonstration trajectories under the Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning Boltzmann model p(x) = exp(-E_theta(x))/Z. Approximates the intractable partition function Z using importance sampling with mixture distribution q(x) = 0.5 p_demo(x) + 0.5 pi(x), while minimizing KL divergence KL(pi || exp(-E_theta)/Z) so the sampling distribution pi generates low-energy negative samples.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Geoffrey E. Hinton, 2002)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `Delta theta proportional to grad_theta E(x^0) - grad_theta E(x^K)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.577` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Training Products of Experts b': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.45. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Training Products of Experts': off-concept clutter (overlap=['gradient']).*
- **Extracted Note:** Approximates intractable log-likelihood gradients of the partition function Z in Boltzmann and energy-based models by running a short K-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) or Langevin sampler to draw negative samples x^K. Contrasts positive data energy E(x^0) against negative sample energy E(x^K).

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Brian D. Ziebart et al., 2008)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `p(x | w) = (1 / Z(w)) exp(-E(x, w))`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.502` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinfo': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'partition_function'], pairwise_synergy=0.44. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Maximum Entropy Inverse Rein': off-concept clutter (overlap=[]).*
- **Extracted Note:** Models demonstrated trajectories x as samples from a Boltzmann distribution p(x|w) = exp(-E(x,w))/Z(w) parameterized by path energy E(x,w) and partition function Z(w). Multiple constraints or concepts compose additively by summing their constituent energy functions.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.

### [[Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Run K=10 Langevin Chains Fail Without KL Shaping]] `[CONTRADICTION_NOTE]` (Research Lab Internal Note, 2025)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `KL(pi_K || p_Boltzmann) >> 0 when trained with L^ML only`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.552` — *[Boltzmann Energy, ] Promote 'Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-Ru': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.44. | [Execution-Time Inn] Suppress 'Lab Notebook #42: Why Short-': off-concept clutter (overlap=['gradient']).*
- **Extracted Note:** CONTROVERSY / CONTRADICTION NOTE: Classical contrastive divergence (Hinton 2002) assumes K-step truncated Langevin MCMC chains mix sufficiently without differentiating through the sampler. However, our experiments contradict uncalibrated short-run MCMC: when training the energy function E_theta with L^ML alone, K=10 Langevin steps fail to reach low-energy modes of the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z (sampled energy stays > 0.74). Differentiating through the K-step SGLD rollout via the sampler KL objective L^KL is mandatory to shape the gradient field grad_x E_theta.

- **Contradiction Reconciled ([[Composite: Boltzmann Sampling + Inner-Loop Meta-Adaptation]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates energy, boltzmann, langevin, partition_function.
